contentText:
John Coogan / @johncoogan :

OpenAI acquires popular tech news show TBPN; the show will stay the same and will continue to air live at 11am PT weekdays   —  TBPN has been acquired by OpenAI! The show is staying the same and we'll continue to go live at 11am pacific every weekday. This is a full circle moment for me as I've worked with @sama for well over a decade.
